scope: Initial resource-version request timeout on a fresh candidate installation; recovered without settings changes or restart

separate_sdk_dns_error.error: UnknownHostException: Unable to resolve host; no address associated with hostname

resolver_counts.limit: All retained queries on this network, not attribution of the two version-request failures

observed_configuration.guest_clock_vs_host: Within approximately 3 seconds of the host capture midpoint; whole-second timestamp and command duration limit accuracy

current_resolved_peers.evidence: Host DNS A records match addresses of game-owned TCP sockets with several KiB received; this does not establish a successful HTTP response

tls_and_http_limits: The two failed version requests report timeout without an HTTP status or explicit certificate/handshake error. TCP bytes received cannot identify the failed protocol stage.

natural_recovery.state: Resource selection reached after checking 16883/16883 files; normal download proceeded

conclusion: Record one transient pre-download version-metadata timeout. DNS instability is a plausible contributor, but the exact timeout stage is unproven. No evidence here establishes a candidate I/O patch fault.
